complete_source_gate: Parent dispatch required before any complete-catalog derivation. Source must have COMPLETE supervisor+worker receipts bound by supplied SHA256, exact original archive SHA256, both shard SHA256, full bzip2 CRC/tar EOF and all counts reconciled.

Read-only source union; verify each packed/raw hash and decode exact lossless metadata; source-bound ordinal/member body hash/original JSON hash in every derived record. Unparsed member identities counted separately, never silently omitted.
Duplicate ebook IDs remain held and separate member records; family nodes connect them conservatively without counting novel works.

filters.language: Known nonempty language set excluding en =>excluded; exact['en']required; multilingual or missing =>held.
filters.type: Known nonempty type set excluding Text=>excluded; exact['Text']required; missing or mixed=>held.
filters.creator: Require every native primary creator has resolved stable authority and no native agent holds; all other roles including translator/editor/illustrator retained unchanged.
filters.format: Require official HTTP(S) Gutenberg URL, explicit text/plain;charset=utf-8 MIME, positive extent, no format holds and every isFormatOf exact source ID. No format fetched.
filters.schema: Every native row hold remains a discovery hold; missing/unknown metadata never repaired by inference.
filters.date: No print-date inferred from PG-issued or contributor dates. All exact primary-creator death years<=1900 priority stratum only; uncertain/missing and later dates remain visible review strata, not erased. No era clears edition or local rights.
filters.genre: No genre excluded. Observed whole-word label matches fiction/stories/novels/tales;history;essays;biography/autobiography/memoirs;poetry/poems/verse;drama/plays. Multi-label overlap explicit. Others unclassified, never inferred content quality.
filters.rights: All works globally held from training/acquisition absent exact work-specific original-English, source-edition, added-contributor and applicable jurisdiction checks. Public-domain-US metadata label does not release this hold.

families.method: Transitive union of explicit official ebook relation edges and identical normalized title+set of primary creator IDs. All conservative discovery components; not proven abstract works. Missing titles/creator IDs fallback stable ebook ID.
families.title_normalization: NFKC,casefold,punctuation to spaces,whitespace collapse; original exact titles preserved.
families.priority: SHA256(gutenberg-native-catalog-discovery-v1 + newline + gutenberg-component:<minimum PGID>), PGID and member ordinal as stable ties. Prioritize historical narrative stratum for first manual provenance review; broad strata remain available. One apparent family does not establish one eligible edition.
families.missing_relation_targets: Explicitly count relation targets outside parsed population; no fabricated nodes or false complete-family claim.

count_contract.discovery_statuses: Three exclusive statuses: excluded, held metadata, eligible for body REVIEW only. Reasons and genre counts nonexclusive.
separate_counts: All archive members, parsed/held potential records and duplicates
Exact-English Text population before creator/format/schema gates
Every contributor role, exact/missing/uncertain date, rights and format missingness
Provisional component count and multiple-edition/translation/contributor flags
All body-rights unverified and training eligible0
count_contract.never_counts: Catalog records, genre labels, metadata extents or contributor death dates are not usable documents/tokens.

prefix_only_observation.caveat: 132 rows have unmapped native fields, including edition/publication-related MARC fields. Parser stores their qualified names/subtree hashes and original RDF archive remains authoritative; do not waive holds or infer full edition verification from metadata.

next_concrete_action: Once full catalog passes, apply frozen classify+family policy to complete decoded record stream, reconcile counts with source receipts, then review actual historical narrative candidates and source/titlepage/credits. Any book-body transfer needs separately bounded approved exact URLs; no automatic fetch.

complete_function.invocation: run(source,dest,expected_worker_SHA256,expected_supervisor_SHA256) only after parent pins and dispatch; parent must provide external600sec/1GBRSS supervision
complete_function.passes: Two read-only record passes: first lightweight family edges; second preserves full role/rights/format metadata into capped deterministic gzip JSONL. No expanded source archive or model. Source receipt/shard tampering rejected before output.
complete_function.tests: 6 synthetic tiny-archive pipeline tests plus12 classifier tests.
